scripts.build: npm run build:darkness && npm run build:functional && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('site/darkness-pro', {recursive:true}); require('fs').mkdirSync('site/functional', {recursive:true});" && cp -r a-ki-pri-sa-ye-darkness-pro/dist/* site/darkness-pro/ && cp -r a-ki-pri-sa-ye-functional/dist/* site/functional/
scripts.build:darkness: npm --prefix a-ki-pri-sa-ye-darkness-pro ci || npm --prefix a-ki-pri-sa-ye-darkness-pro install && npm --prefix a-ki-pri-sa-ye-darkness-pro run build -- --base=/darkness-pro/
scripts.build:functional: npm --prefix a-ki-pri-sa-ye-functional ci || npm --prefix a-ki-pri-sa-ye-functional install && npm --prefix a-ki-pri-sa-ye-functional run build -- --base=/functional/
